method: New canonical_api_small workload, no pre-M3f5 API baseline. Three separate release processes. 100 parses/constructors/typed batches timed separately; 100 direct canonical ATK2 entries each in a fresh same-input setup, target/roster installation outside timers; 1000 complete binding/definition queries; 100 existing script updates each preceded by a canonical identity query, including snapshots. Native wait4 peak RSS covers process/allocator overhead. Not directly comparable with old workloads that omit these queries, no isolated CPU/frequency control, no performance threshold.
